Good morning! What did you do on the weekend?
I went on a tour of the old city, with a guide.
Nice. Did you like it?
Yes, I did. The guide was great, and the view from the castle was beautiful.
Did you go to the museum?
No, I didn't. It was closed. But I took a hundred photos.
A hundred! And did you buy anything?
I bought a souvenir for my son. A small blue boat.
That is lovely. He is a lucky boy.

I went to the beach with my sister. We had lunch there, and we ate fish.

Last weekend I finally had two free days in Rome, and I did not plan anything. On Saturday morning I got up late, I had a big breakfast, and I went for a walk with no map. I saw a small church, a market and a beautiful old square. I ate pizza in the street, like everybody. In the afternoon I took a bus to the wrong place, and it was the best mistake of the trip, because I found a little museum with no tourists in it. On Sunday I bought two souvenirs, one for my mother and one for me, and I went to the airport happy. Two days, no plan, and I did not miss anything.

Everybody asks me about my weekend in Cape Town, so here it is. I went there for the sun, and it rained for two days. On Saturday I went to the beach anyway, and I was the only person there. I sat in a small cafe and I had three coffees. I did not see the famous view from the mountain, because there were clouds everywhere. On Sunday I took a bus to the old town and I saw a music show in the street. That was the best part. I did not swim, and I did not take one good photo. But I met a family from Argentina, and we had dinner together. So, a bad weekend? No. A different weekend.
